title: KINDRED CORD bracelet capsule launch: neutralise an 8-style two-session studio batch to one house white point, bring every clasp to one true house metal, isolate onto matched white PDPs, author the homepage hero, vectorize the mark and merge the line-sheet
grounding_note: Adapted from a real Upwork brief that asked a jewelry/accessory DESIGNER to take a 'signature bracelet' for a new lifestyle-and-cultural brand (centred on gathering, celebration, connection) from concept through manufacturing — materials, closures, prototyping, factory coordination. That from-scratch industrial/product DESIGN deliverable is out of Adobe-connector scope (no CAD, no from-scratch art, no compositing) and is not attempted here. The task is honestly re-cast to the photography-post-production / brand-launch-imaging slice any such program needs once prototypes exist, and SCALED UP from a single hero to the real launch workload: the brand has photographed its opening capsule of EIGHT woven-cord bracelet styles across TWO studio sessions on different days, dropped a neutral grey reference card in every frame, and supplied a flat wordmark plus an authored line-sheet template and SKU sheet. The client name, the fictional brand KINDRED CORD, the eight style names, all copy, the metal-finish split and the price data are invented for this benchmark; a coined compound in the woven-cord accessory space, it is not confusably close to a dominant real trademark. Only Upwork (the sourcing platform) is a real name. No bracelet is designed from scratch — every pixel originates from client-supplied captures and assets; no generative fill/expand, no compositing, no text-to-image, no layout-by-coordinates is claimed.
one_line_ask: Take eight KINDRED CORD bracelet photos shot across two mismatched studio sessions (each with a grey reference card in frame), neutralise every frame to the card so the capsule reads as one white point and brightness, bring each clasp to its one true house metal across the whole set, isolate every bracelet onto a clean solid-white PDP without wrecking the fine cord and clasp edges, author an elevated close-up homepage hero from tonal primitives, vectorize the wordmark, and merge one typeset line-sheet card per style.
full_brief:
We are launching KINDRED CORD, a lifestyle brand built around gathering and connection, and our opening capsule is eight woven-cord bracelet styles — the same signature silhouette in eight cord colourways and three clasp finishes (yellow-gold, rose-gold and brushed silver). We photographed the whole capsule ourselves over two sessions on two different days and rooms, so the raw set does not match: some styles run cool and a touch dark, others run warm and a touch bright, the light-grey seamless reads a different shade shot to shot, and the reference card and messy sweep are still in every frame. Because we knew the light was inconsistent, we clipped a neutral grey balance card (an 18% grey patch beside a small white patch) into the edge of every frame so you have an honest thing to balance against.

What we need back, and the bar we will judge it on:

1) The whole eight-style set corrected so that the grey card in each frame reads truly neutral — no residual warm, cool or green cast — and so the set sits at one consistent brightness and white point. A customer scrolling the collection page must not be able to tell which styles came from which session. Tell us, per photo, the white-balance and exposure you landed on, so we can confirm the set was genuinely matched to the card and not just eyeballed one frame at a time.

2) Every clasp brought to its one true house metal, consistent across the whole capsule — our yellow-gold must read as the same warm 18k gold on every style regardless of which session it was shot in, and every metal must stay true to its own finish. Keep the brushed and polished texture and the micro-detail of the metal real; we do not want a flat painted-on colour.

3) Each bracelet cleanly lifted off the sweep and set on a pure solid-white PDP backdrop (#FFFFFF), with the reference card and seamless gone and the fine cord weave and delicate clasp edges kept clean — no halo, no chewed edges. The bracelets are laid open (clasp undone, a relaxed curve, not a closed loop) so there is no interior hole to worry about.

4) An elevated, warm, timeless close-up HOMEPAGE HERO of our signature style — a composed editorial look that is yours to art-direct, with the macro clasp detail as the focal point, delivered as a 4:5 portrait.

5) Our flat wordmark turned into clean vector art so it scales for packaging, the site and the woven hang-tags.

6) Using the line-sheet template and the SKU sheet we are sending, one finished line-sheet card per style with its cleaned packshot placed and its name, cord colourway and price set in type.

Deliver: the eight matched masters as a contact set we can eyeball against the card, the eight isolated white-background packshots, the 4:5 homepage hero, the vector wordmark, and the merged line-sheet. Keep the look elevated, warm and timeless to match the brand.

inputs.name: KC01_harbor_navy_flatlay.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal top-down ecommerce flat-lay of a single woven navy waxed-cord bracelet with a polished yellow-gold barrel clasp and a small engraved gold charm, laid OPEN in a relaxed shallow curve (clasp undone, NOT a closed loop) on a plain light-grey seamless paper sweep. A standard 18-percent neutral grey reference card with a small white patch sits flat on the sweep at the lower-left edge of the frame. Shot under COOL north-window daylight with a distinct blue-cyan cast, slightly flat and marginally under-exposed, straight off the camera, un-graded. Real waxed-cord weave and fibre detail, fine brushed-then-polished gold with tiny realistic micro-scratches and accurate specular highlights, faint soft contact shadow. 3:2, 4000x2667px, documentary catalog capture, not CGI-glossy.
inputs.realism_notes: SKU KC-01 'Harbor', Session A (cool/blue, slightly under), and the signature style used for the homepage hero. The cool cast pushes the yellow-gold toward a greenish-brass; it must be neutralised to the in-frame grey card (WARM the temperature, lift exposure) and then its gold matched to the SAME house yellow-gold as the warm-session gold SKUs. Laid OPEN in a curve so there is no enclosed interior counter — remove_background isolates the outer sweep cleanly and no interior hole is punched (the connector cannot punch an enclosed hole). Grey card is the neutralisation ground truth.

inputs.name: KC02_ember_oxblood_flatlay.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal top-down ecommerce flat-lay of a single woven oxblood-red waxed-cord bracelet with a polished yellow-gold barrel clasp, laid OPEN in a relaxed shallow curve (clasp undone, not a loop) on a light-grey seamless paper sweep. A standard 18-percent neutral grey reference card with a small white patch sits on the sweep at the lower-right edge. Shot under WARM tungsten work-light with a strong orange cast and slightly bright exposure, un-graded. Real cord weave, micro-scratched polished gold with accurate speculars, soft contact shadow. 3:2, 4000x2667px, documentary catalog capture, not CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: SKU KC-02 'Ember', Session B (warm/orange, slightly bright). Same yellow-gold clasp family as KC-01 but photographed under the OPPOSITE cast, so a single shared white-balance across the batch cannot neutralise both — this is the uniform-WB trap. Correct move is the opposite sign to KC-01 (COOL the temperature, pull exposure down) to the card, then the masked clasp pass lands its gold on the identical house target as KC-01/03/06/08.

inputs.name: KC03_ridge_olive_flatlay.jpg

Real cord weave, micro-scratched polished gold speculars, soft contact shadow. 3:2, 4000x2667px, documentary catalog capture, not CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: SKU KC-03 'Ridge', Session B (warm). Yellow-gold clasp — must match the same house gold as KC-01/02/06/08 across the two sessions. The warm cast also pushes the olive cord toward khaki; neutralisation to the card must bring the cord back to a believable olive without a separate recolor (cord is not the metal-match target).

inputs.name: KC04_dune_sand_flatlay.jpg
inputs.gen_prompt: Photoreal top-down ecommerce flat-lay of a single woven sand/tan waxed-cord bracelet with a polished ROSE-GOLD barrel clasp (a warm pink-copper gold, distinct from yellow-gold), laid OPEN in a relaxed shallow curve on a light-grey seamless paper sweep. A standard 18-percent neutral grey reference card with a small white patch sits on the sweep at the frame edge. Shot under WARM tungsten work-light with an orange cast, un-graded. Real cord weave, polished rose-gold with pink-copper speculars and micro-scratches, soft contact shadow. 3:2, 4000x2667px, documentary catalog capture, not CGI.
inputs.realism_notes: SKU KC-04 'Dune', Session B (warm). THE TRIAGE TRAP: under the warm orange cast this rose-gold clasp looks almost identical to the yellow-gold clasps, so a naive agent that matches every clasp to the one house yellow-gold will destroy the rose finish and nobody notices until inspected against the real product. Correct treatment: neutralise to the card, then hold this metal on its true ROSE-gold house target — a DIFFERENT metal answer from the five yellow-gold SKUs. Getting the routing wrong is invisible in the thumbnail.

inputs.name: kindred_cord_wordmark.png
inputs.gen_prompt: A clean minimalist lifestyle-brand wordmark reading 'KINDRED CORD' in an elegant high-contrast serif, deep charcoal letters on a transparent background, with a small simple line-art knotted-cord loop glyph to the left of the words. Flat single-charcoal-colour mark, crisp hard edges, centred, generous padding, high resolution, no gradients, no photographic texture, suitable for tracing to SVG. 2400x800 transparent PNG.
inputs.realism_notes: Flat single-colour text-bearing raster with crisp edges — the ideal candidate for image_vectorize to trace cleanly to a scalable SVG for packaging, site and woven hang-tags. gemini-3-pro-image chosen because the mark carries legible type. This is the flat-raster arm of the wordmark job: it is vectorized directly (feeding a selection would return a black silhouette), whereas the photographed metal charms in the packshots are NOT traced — that would garbage.

inputs.name: kindred_linesheet_card.indd
inputs.gen_prompt: AUTHORED asset (client-supplied, not model-generated): a genuine single-page InDesign line-sheet card template (~4x6 in at 300 DPI plus bleed) with an image frame carrying an @-prefixed image-path variable and live text merge fields <<style_name>>, <<cord_colour>>, <<price>>, the vectorized wordmark placed on the master page. Built as a real .indd (never a convert_pdf_to_indd output) with a data-merge source so document_merge_data_layout binds one card per row.
inputs.realism_notes: Supplied so the composed endpoint is real: a genuine authored .indd with live <<fields>> AND an @-image column is the only connector-legal way to place an image into a laid-out page. document_merge_data_vector is the WRONG tool (text-only, cannot bind the image column); a convert_pdf_to_indd target would silently fail to bind. The template layout is the client's; the distinctive quality of each finished card (matched packshot, true metal, preserved fine edges) is the agent's work.

inputs.name: kindred_capsule_skus.csv
inputs.gen_prompt: AUTHORED asset (client-supplied): an 8-row data-merge CSV, one row per style (KC-01..KC-08), with text columns style_name, cord_colour, price and an @-prefixed image-path column (@packshot) whose cells must resolve to the eight isolated white-background packshots the agent produces. Header names match the <<fields>> in the .indd template. No clasp/metal/finish column is present.
inputs.realism_notes: The @packshot column is the binding contract: the agent must point each cell at its OWN produced isolated packshot (named by the agent per its own triage), so document_merge_data_layout places each cleaned bracelet on its card — the column carries only image paths the agent authors, never a treatment/type telegraph (no .svg-vs-.png or metal-type hint). The metal FINISH is deliberately NOT a data column: the agent must decide each clasp's true metal BY EYE against the neutralised master, so the merge data cannot hand it the metal-triage answer; the per-SKU finish ground truth is retained only as realism_notes metadata the agent does not consume. Row count = 8 fixes the page=row acceptance gate.

outputs.name: capsule_masters_contact_x8
outputs.spec: The eight retouched masters as one matched contact set WITH the grey reference card still in frame (this is the retained card-bearing artifact the grader measures neutrality on): each frame neutralised to its in-frame grey card (card reads neutral, no residual warm/cool/green cast; card mid-grey within ~4 levels of a common target across the set; ~3-level channel spread tolerance on the card), the shared house-look tonal shape applied, and each clasp brought to its true house metal via masked HSL. Full-res PNG (~4000x2667). All eight styles present and visibly consistent style-to-style. DELIVERABLE 1.

outputs.name: packshots_matched_x8
outputs.spec: Eight bracelet packshots (KC-01..KC-08), each isolated off the sweep onto a pure solid-white PDP backdrop (#FFFFFF) via image_remove_background({backgroundColor}) with the sweep and the grey card GONE and the fine cord/clasp edges clean (no halo). sRGB JPEG, long edge 2048 px, and at least 300 effective DPI at the 4x6 card trim. Acceptance: the grey card is EXCLUDED from every delivered packshot (neutrality is graded on capsule_masters_contact_x8, card-exclusion is checked here separately), the set sits at one shared white point/brightness, no white clipped to 255 / no black crushed to 0, and the agent must REPORT its final per-image white-balance (temp/tint) and exposure. DELIVERABLE 2.

outputs.name: homepage_hero_closeup_4x5
outputs.spec: A 4:5 portrait (~2048x2560) elevated close-up homepage hero built from the signature style (KC-01) matched master, carrying an agent-AUTHORED warm editorial look composed from tonal primitives (split highlight-warm / shadow-cool toning, contrast, clarity, black point — NOT a canned preset, NOT auto-tone) with a gentle macro depth-of-field fall-off so the polished clasp detail is the focal point. The distinctive quality of this frame is the agent's art-direction. DELIVERABLE 3.

outputs.name: kindred_cord_logo.svg
outputs.spec: Vector SVG of the KINDRED CORD wordmark (charcoal serif type + knotted-cord glyph) traced from the flat single-colour raster, crisp scalable paths for packaging, site and woven hang-tags. DELIVERABLE 4.

outputs.name: linesheet_x8_pdf
outputs.spec: Eight per-style line-sheet cards, ONE PDF card per CSV row, produced by merging kindred_capsule_skus.csv into the authored kindred_linesheet_card.indd via document_merge_data_layout: each card places that style's matched packshot through the @packshot image column and typesets <<style_name>>, <<cord_colour>>, <<price>>. Acceptance gate: card/page count == data row count == 8 (a broken or empty-frame merge fails this); each placed packshot renders at >=300 DPI at the card trim. DELIVERABLE 5.

chaining_note: One batch upload (1) fans into eight parallel per-style grade chains. Each style runs a three-step sub-chain: image_apply_adjustments neutralises THAT frame's specific cast to its in-frame grey card and lays the shared house-look constants (WB/exposure differ per frame, tonal shape constant); image_select_by_prompt isolates the metal clasp; image_adjust_hsl consumes [neutral, clasp_mask] to bring the metal to its true house finish, emitting that style's card-bearing matched master (steps 2-4 KC-01, 5-7 KC-02, 8-10 KC-03, 11-13 KC-04, 14-16 KC-05, 17-19 KC-06, 20-22 KC-07, 23-25 KC-08 = capsule_masters_contact_x8, card retained). The eight masters then fan into image_remove_background({backgroundColor:#FFFFFF}) knockouts (26-33, card and sweep dropped), each resized to the shared web/card spec (34-41 = packshots_matched_x8 and the eight @packshot cells). The signature master's card-free packshot additionally feeds the hero branch: image_apply_adjustments authors the editorial look (43) -> image_apply_lens_blur macro fall-off (44) -> image_crop_and_resize 4:5 (45 = homepage_hero_closeup_4x5).
